case_167.label_scope: Fixed implementation decision over all legal byte arrays, independent of chosen test inputs.
case_167.analysis: All 256 scalar values are exhausted, including every value at every lane of the 256-element GPU block. The kernel uses independent integer-only lanes: index = program_id*256 + lane, with the same index<N mask on load and store. Every legal element is covered once and every tail access is masked. All byte arithmetic stays in uint32 range. This source argument extends scalar correctness to any legal arrangement and length; tested lengths, offsets, storage guards and fresh output give separate execution checks. The claim is confined to the stated GPU environment and does not exhaust every tensor execution or prove hardware correctness.
